label: First Vatican Council, Dei Filius Ch. 3…: The Church by itself, through its wonderful propagation…
locator: ch. 3, para. 5: Quin etiam Ecclesia per se ipsa ... magnum quoddam et perpetuum est motivum credibilitatis
interpretation: The Church 'per se ipsa', because of its admirable propagation, eminent holiness, inexhaustible fruitfulness in all good things, catholic unity and unconquered stability, is a great and perpetual motive of credibility and an irrefutable witness ('testimonium irrefragabile') of its divine mission ('divinae suae legationis'). Read as the council's claim that these observable features of the Church are evidence of its divine mission. It names the evidence for (A); it is not (A), and the historical findings behind each feature would enter as their own sourced premises (owner decision on #143).
